description: Python scripts copied byte-for-byte from the versions supplied for MLE reanalysis. Static design matrices were generated from their make_design functions.
run_evidence: Full run logs and completed MLE result tables have not been archived in this repository. This snapshot does not establish which outputs entered the manuscript.
validation: Five Python files parse and match the supplied source bytes.
Nine current design matrices have unique sample rows, full column rank and the declared treatment contrast.
Clements input preparation and the original MAGeCK 0.5.9.5 count loader were previously checked on both 77441-guide exports; no MLE fit was performed for this upload.
